name: Meryl Streep
hook: A chameleon who disappears into accents, from Sophie's Choice to The Devil Wears Prada.

facts.label: Kramer vs. Kramer
facts.statement: Kramer vs. Kramer (1979) cast Dustin Hoffman and Streep as the divorcing title couple; Justin Henry earned an Oscar nomination as their son.

facts.label: Sophie's Choice
facts.statement: For Sophie's Choice (1982) Streep learned German and Polish; the film was Kevin Kline's debut.

facts.label: The Devil Wears Prada
facts.statement: In The Devil Wears Prada (2006) she plays Runway editor Miranda Priestly and delivers the cerulean-blue rant.

facts.label: Julie & Julia
facts.statement: Julie & Julia (2009) has Streep as Julia Child, with Mastering the Art of French Cooking at its heart and Amy Adams as Julie.

facts.label: Mamma Mia!
facts.statement: Mamma Mia! (2008) had her singing the ABBA title song while her character's daughter sorts out three possible fathers.

facts.label: Out of Africa
facts.statement: Out of Africa (1985), the only Best Picture winner with a continent in its title, has Klaus Maria Brandauer as Bror Blixen opposite Streep.

facts.label: Vassar
facts.statement: Streep acted in a campus production of Miss Julie at Vassar, then trained at Yale School of Drama.
